questions.question_en: What are the major physiological functions of blood?
questions.answer_en: Transport, buffering, thermoregulation, defense, and hemostasis
questions.analysis_zh: 血液运输气体、激素、营养物质和代谢产物，并参与酸碱缓冲、体温维持、防御免疫和生理性止血。

questions.question_en: What is the main difference between plasma and interstitial fluid?
questions.analysis_zh: 血浆蛋白分子大，不易透过毛细血管壁，因此组织液中蛋白含量很少。

questions.question_en: Which plasma protein contributes most to plasma colloid osmotic pressure?
questions.analysis_zh: 白蛋白分子量较小、数量最多，因此血浆胶体渗透压主要来自白蛋白。

questions.question_en: Why does a decrease in plasma protein concentration cause edema?
questions.analysis_zh: 血浆胶体渗透压降低时，毛细血管内保水能力下降，组织液生成增多而发生水肿。

questions.question_en: What does hematocrit mainly reflect in normal blood?
questions.analysis_zh: 白细胞和血小板所占容积极小，因此血细胞比容主要反映红细胞在血液中的相对浓度。

questions.question_en: What mainly determines whole-blood viscosity?
questions.analysis_zh: 全血黏滞度主要受血细胞比容影响；血浆黏滞度主要受血浆蛋白含量影响。

questions.question_en: Which component contributes most to plasma crystal osmotic pressure?
questions.analysis_zh: 血浆晶体渗透压主要来自晶体物质，其中约80%来自Na+和Cl-。

questions.question_en: Why is 0.9% NaCl considered both iso-osmotic and isotonic for red blood cells?
questions.answer_en: NaCl cannot freely cross RBC membranes
questions.analysis_zh: 0.9% NaCl与血浆等渗，且NaCl不易自由通过红细胞膜，因此能维持红细胞正常形态。

questions.question_en: Why does an iso-osmotic urea solution still cause hemolysis?
questions.answer_en: Urea freely enters red blood cells
questions.analysis_zh: 尿素可自由进入红细胞，使细胞内渗透压升高，水进入细胞后导致红细胞胀破。

questions.question_en: What is the most important buffer pair in plasma?
questions.analysis_zh: 血浆主要缓冲对包括碳酸氢盐、蛋白质和磷酸盐缓冲对，其中NaHCO3/H2CO3最重要。

questions.question_en: What are the two major types of immunity described in blood physiology?
questions.analysis_zh: 固有免疫无抗原特异性，是第一道防线；获得性免疫具有特异性，包括体液免疫和细胞免疫。

questions.question_en: Which cells are the main executors of acquired immunity?
questions.analysis_zh: B细胞分化为浆细胞产生抗体，主要参与体液免疫；T细胞主要参与细胞免疫。

questions.question_en: What are the key abilities of hematopoietic stem cells?
questions.analysis_zh: 造血干细胞可自我更新、多向分化，并具有重建长期造血的能力。

questions.question_en: What is the main pathological change in aplastic anemia?
questions.analysis_zh: 造血干细胞数量减少、功能异常或造血微环境缺陷，可导致全血细胞减少。

questions.question_en: What is the only energy-producing pathway in mature red blood cells?
questions.analysis_zh: 成熟红细胞没有线粒体，只能通过糖酵解产生ATP，以维持钠泵和双凹圆碟形。

questions.question_en: What shape do normal mature red blood cells have?
questions.analysis_zh: 双凹圆碟形使红细胞具有较大的表面积与体积比，有利于气体交换和变形通过毛细血管。

questions.question_en: What is the most important property for red blood cells to pass through narrow capillaries and splenic sinuses?
questions.analysis_zh: 红细胞必须变形才能通过比自身直径更小的毛细血管和脾窦孔隙。

questions.question_en: What mainly determines red blood cell deformability?
questions.analysis_zh: 红细胞变形性取决于几何形状、细胞内黏滞度和膜弹性，其中双凹圆碟形最重要。

questions.question_en: What does an increased erythrocyte sedimentation rate usually indicate at the plasma level?
questions.analysis_zh: 红细胞叠连使总表面积与总体积之比下降，摩擦力减小，血沉加快。

questions.question_en: Which plasma proteins tend to increase erythrocyte sedimentation rate?
questions.analysis_zh: 纤维蛋白原和球蛋白可中和红细胞表面负电荷，促进叠连，使血沉加快。

questions.question_en: What is red blood cell osmotic fragility?
questions.answer_en: Tendency to hemolyze in hypotonic saline
questions.analysis_zh: 红细胞在低渗盐溶液中吸水膨胀并破裂的特性称为渗透脆性。

questions.question_en: What is the main function of red blood cells?
questions.analysis_zh: 红细胞主要运输氧和二氧化碳，也参与酸碱缓冲和免疫复合物清除。

questions.question_en: What type of anemia results from iron deficiency?
questions.analysis_zh: 铁是合成血红蛋白的必需原料，缺铁会使血红蛋白合成减少。

questions.question_en: What type of anemia results from folate or vitamin B12 deficiency?
questions.analysis_zh: 叶酸或维生素B12缺乏导致DNA合成障碍，细胞核发育滞后，红细胞体积增大。

questions.question_en: Which gastric factor is required for vitamin B12 absorption?
questions.analysis_zh: 内因子由胃壁细胞分泌，与维生素B12结合后促进其在回肠远端吸收。

questions.question_en: Which hormone is the main regulator of red blood cell production?
questions.analysis_zh: EPO主要作用于晚期红系祖细胞，促进其存活、分化和红细胞生成。

questions.question_en: Which organ is the main source of erythropoietin in adults?
questions.analysis_zh: EPO主要由肾皮质肾小管周围间质细胞产生，组织缺氧是其分泌的重要刺激。

questions.question_en: Why do patients with advanced kidney disease often develop renal anemia?
questions.analysis_zh: 晚期肾脏病时肾实质破坏，EPO生成不足，骨髓红细胞生成减少。

questions.question_en: What is the average lifespan of normal red blood cells?
questions.analysis_zh: 衰老红细胞主要因变形能力下降和脆性增高，被脾、肝、骨髓中的巨噬细胞吞噬。

questions.question_en: Which white blood cells are the first major phagocytes to arrive at an acute bacterial infection site?
questions.analysis_zh: 中性粒细胞游走速度快、吞噬活性强，是急性炎症早期首先到达的主要效应细胞。

questions.question_en: What do blood monocytes become after entering tissues?
questions.analysis_zh: 单核细胞进入组织后发育为巨噬细胞，吞噬能力增强，并可呈递抗原、分泌细胞因子。

questions.question_en: Which leukocytes are especially important in defense against helminth larvae and in allergic disease?
questions.analysis_zh: 嗜酸性粒细胞可杀伤蠕虫幼体，也参与过敏反应和哮喘中的组织损伤。

questions.question_en: Which leukocytes release histamine, heparin, and leukotrienes during allergic reactions?
questions.analysis_zh: 嗜碱性粒细胞释放组胺、白三烯等，引起毛细血管通透性增加和支气管平滑肌收缩。

questions.question_en: From which bone marrow cells are platelets derived?
questions.analysis_zh: 血小板是骨髓成熟巨核细胞胞质裂解脱落形成的小块胞质。

questions.question_en: Which hormone is the most important physiological regulator of platelet production?
questions.analysis_zh: TPO主要由肝细胞产生，可促进巨核系祖细胞存活、增殖和不成熟巨核细胞分化。

questions.question_en: Which platelet receptor complex mediates adhesion through von Willebrand factor?
questions.analysis_zh: vWF先结合暴露的胶原，再与血小板GPⅠb/Ⅸ/Ⅴ结合，是血小板黏附的桥梁。

questions.question_en: Which platelet receptor mediates aggregation by binding fibrinogen?
questions.analysis_zh: 血小板活化后GPⅡb/Ⅲa亲和力增高，纤维蛋白原在Ca2+参与下连接相邻血小板。

questions.question_en: Which platelet product promotes aggregation and vasoconstriction?
questions.analysis_zh: TXA2可促进血小板聚集和血管收缩，并降低血小板内cAMP，形成正反馈。

questions.question_en: How do PGI2 and nitric oxide inhibit platelet aggregation?
questions.answer_en: PGI2 increases cAMP; NO increases cGMP
questions.analysis_zh: PGI2通过提高血小板cAMP抑制聚集；NO通过提高cGMP抑制聚集。

questions.question_en: What are the three basic processes of physiological hemostasis?
questions.answer_en: Vasoconstriction, platelet plug formation, and coagulation
questions.analysis_zh: 生理性止血包括血管收缩、血小板止血栓形成和血液凝固，三者相互促进。

questions.question_en: What is the essential change during blood coagulation?
questions.analysis_zh: 血液凝固的实质是可溶性纤维蛋白原转变为不溶性纤维蛋白，形成血凝块。

questions.question_en: Which coagulation factors require vitamin K for synthesis?
questions.analysis_zh: FⅡ、FⅦ、FⅨ、FⅩ为维生素K依赖性凝血因子，华法林可抑制其合成。

questions.question_en: Which coagulation pathway is initiated by tissue factor?
questions.analysis_zh: 组织因子暴露于血液后与FⅦa结合，启动外源性凝血途径。

questions.question_en: Which pathway is considered the key initiator of physiological coagulation in vivo?
questions.analysis_zh: 体内生理性凝血主要由组织因子启动，截短的内源性途径主要参与放大和维持凝血反应。

questions.question_en: Deficiency of which coagulation factor causes hemophilia A?
questions.analysis_zh: 血友病A为FⅧ缺陷；血友病B为FⅨ缺陷，均可导致严重凝血障碍。

questions.question_en: Which natural anticoagulant inactivates most thrombin and is greatly enhanced by heparin?
questions.analysis_zh: 抗凝血酶可灭活凝血酶及多种活化凝血因子，肝素可显著增强其抗凝作用。

questions.question_en: How does the protein C system limit coagulation spread?
questions.analysis_zh: 凝血酶与内皮细胞凝血酶调节蛋白结合后激活蛋白C，后者水解灭活FⅤa和FⅧa。

questions.question_en: Which enzyme directly degrades fibrin during fibrinolysis?
questions.analysis_zh: 纤溶酶可降解纤维蛋白和纤维蛋白原，生成纤维蛋白降解产物FDP。

questions.question_en: What antibodies are found in the serum of a person with type O blood?
questions.analysis_zh: O型红细胞无A、B抗原，血清中含抗A和抗B抗体。

questions.question_en: Why is cross-match testing required even when donor and recipient have the same ABO blood type?
questions.analysis_zh: 交叉配血可检验血型鉴定是否有误，并发现ABO以外其他不相容抗原或抗体。
